name: mod-plugin
description: Claude Code mods by Dhiraj Nikam: Cockpit, a side pane and band that show what a session is doing and give you its controls

plugins.name: cockpit
plugins.description: Progress, an autopilot that works on a goal until the judges agree it is done, agents with trackers, memory and testers, a feature map of your codebase, a Rules tab for hooks, permissions and instructions, and a git graph, around the prompt and in a side pane

plugins.name: cockpit-core
plugins.description: Cockpit's core: the state, the events, the experts, /cockpit and the pane's header; add the tabs you want as cockpit-overview, -activity, -agents, -git and -rules, and the chat's band and cards as cockpit-chat

plugins.name: cockpit-overview
plugins.description: Cockpit's Overview tab: the task's progress ring and steps, checks, the agents as a neural view, changed files, context, and the judges' decisions

plugins.name: cockpit-activity
plugins.description: Cockpit's Activity tab: a live feed of every file read, edited or searched, the codebase's features as a map, and the impact of a change

plugins.name: cockpit-agents
plugins.description: Cockpit's Agents tab: the Build, Verify and Review pipelines, the six experts, agents you describe, their trackers and two testers on every change

plugins.name: cockpit-git
plugins.description: Cockpit's Git tab: the next commit written from the diff, commit modes from manual to automatic, accounts, and a git graph of every branch

plugins.name: cockpit-rules
plugins.description: Cockpit's Rules tab: the hooks, permission rules and CLAUDE.md instructions of the repository or of you, to add, edit and delete

plugins.name: cockpit-chat
plugins.description: Cockpit around the chat: the band above the prompt with progress and context, the spinner's words, tool calls as cards, and the line under the prompt
